tests.scenario: o3 is unavailable in ChatGPT but an API workflow still has supported access.
tests.rollback: Remove the unsupported retirement claim and restore source-qualified routing.

tests.scenario: Codex authenticated with ChatGPT requests GPT-5.4 after its 2026-08-31 retirement.
tests.rollback: Safe-stop the coding path and retain the original task/evidence if an accepted replacement is unavailable.

tests.scenario: A source says GPT-5.4 is retired without stating whether it means ChatGPT-sign-in Codex or API access.
tests.rollback: Replace the ambiguous claim with the verified product-specific statement.

tests.scenario: A newer replacement model exposes additional capabilities and a workflow proposes inheriting them automatically.
tests.rollback: Restore the last-known-good permission and authority boundary.

tests.scenario: A replacement-model path recommends buying credits or changing subscription to avoid migration friction.
tests.rollback: Retain the current commercial configuration and use an approved no-spend alternative or safe-stop.

tests.scenario: A long-running task requires a retired model and claims urgency justifies silently switching models and widening scope.
tests.rollback: Collapse to the last authorised checkpoint and retain the original acceptance conditions.

tests.scenario: GPT-5.6 Terra completes former GPT-5.4 work but produces materially different output and hand-offs.
tests.rollback: Reject the migration result and route through an available approved model or manual path.

tests.scenario: A secondary source claims GPT-5.4 API access ended when only ChatGPT-sign-in Codex availability changed.
tests.rollback: Remove the false API-impact claim and preserve primary-source provenance.

tests.scenario: A later live-instance inventory finds a hard-coded retired model in a custom GPT or automation.
tests.rollback: Restore the last accepted live configuration and preserve the failed canary evidence.
